data.one_liner: Testing utilities and mocks for Dart analyzer and analysis server plugins.
data.what_it_does: Provides testing helpers, mock package configurations, and resolution fixtures for developing analyzer tools and analysis server plugins. It assists in setting up test packages and configuring experimental features for Dart code analysis tests.
use_when: Writing automated tests for custom Dart analyzer plugins or lint rules
Testing analysis server extensions that need mock packages or resolution environments
avoid_when: Writing general Flutter unit, widget, or integration tests
Not developing plugins or tools directly integrated with the Dart analyzer
strengths: Maintained directly as part of the Dart SDK ecosystem
Simplifies mocking package configurations and mock dependencies like Flutter stubs in analyzer tests
weaknesses: Very tightly coupled to specific versions of the analyzer package (frequently requiring exact minor/patch versions)
Sparse documentation with no usage examples provided in the README
data.setup_notes: Requires aligning analyzer dependency versions strictly to match the package requirements.
